decisions.question: Gate 3 re-ship, delegated under the standing instruction of 2026-10-01: char-elf-soldier with its maps of 1024 px or more halved (resize_maps.py, then meshopt_glb.mjs; geometry, skin and clips byte-identical) is in the running game (board _reviews/gate3-resize-large). The file falls from 862,908 to 571,768 bytes. In isolated renders 0.0% of its pixels differ by more than 8/255 at 18 m (0.147% at pixel ratio 1.75, 0.0% at 26 m), tone ratio 0.9991; in the game (three factions, 18 and 26 m, pixel ratio 1 and 1.75) at most 0.019% of a frame differs by more than 8/255. Close-ups are softer (9.925% of pixels over 8/255). Shader programs are unchanged. Should I ship it?
